You are building chunk C2 of cpanel-mail-mcp, a Cloudflare Worker remote MCP server that gives Claude IMAP access to Scott's three cPanel business mailboxes. Read `docs/spec.md` (tag `spec-v1.2`), `docs/build/traceability.md`, `docs/prerequisites.md` and `docs/build/spec-questions.md` before writing code.

## Goal

Build the pure logic for accounts, folder resolution, the filter grammar and message IDs. No network beyond what tests mock.

1. Build to `docs/spec.md` at git tag `spec-v1.2`. Do not edit `docs/spec.md`, `docs/rule-base.md`, `docs/ambiguity-log.md` or `docs/design.md`.
2. Implement only the requirements listed under "In scope". Do not add behavior the spec does not state, even if it seems obviously useful.

Add an entry to `docs/build/spec-questions.md` (format below), skip that item, finish the rest, and list the question in the PR. Scott resolves it and, if needed, the spec gets a version bump.
4. Every automated test's name starts with the REQ IDs it verifies, for example `REQ-4-7 REQ-4-8: greeting times out after 5 s`.
5. Add `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C2 --strict` to the unit job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, next to the earlier chunks' lines.
5a. Fill the "Verified by" column of `docs/build/traceability.md` for every in-scope row (test file and test name, or the manual check to perform). Set Status to `built` for automated rows that pass, or `needs Scott` for manual rows.
6. No secrets in the repo, logs, test output or PR. Passwords are entered by Scott with `wrangler secret put` only. Never print a secret value.
7. Work on branch `chunk/C2`. Open a pull request titled `C2: Accounts, folders, filters, message IDs`. Do not merge it. Stop after opening the PR.
8. The PR description contains: in-scope REQs and their status, the exact commands you ran with their pass/fail results, anything deferred and why, and any spec questions raised.

## Deliverables

- Account registry from static config with the exact fields, secret names and purpose map (section 2). Production values from the spec and `docs/prerequisites.md`; staging values for the test mailboxes.
- Folder resolver: SPECIAL-USE first, name fallback rules, override support, errors (section 5).
- Filter translator for exactly the REQ-18-1 token table, date math in America/Indianapolis, unknown tokens are errors (section 7).
- Message ID codec and lookup fallback order (section 8).

## Required tests

- Resolver tests using the real cPanel A and cPanel B LIST fixtures from C1, including the duplicate junk folder (INBOX.spam vs INBOX.Junk).
- Translator tests for every filter string in REQ-7-10 (REQ-14-14) and the MAILER-DAEMON / postmaster case (REQ-14-13).
- Codec round-trip and fallback-order tests.
- Integration (staging): folder resolution on both test mailboxes, Archive present on both (REQ-5-10, REQ-2-4).

- REQ-14-4 (owned by C0) is only partly verified. Add the cPanel B folder, SPECIAL-USE and Archive integration tests here and append them to the REQ-14-4 "Verified by" cell.

- Housekeeping from the C1 review: add `--test-timeout=20000` to the `test` and `test:integration` scripts in `package.json`, and `timeout-minutes: 15` to both CI jobs, so a protocol regression fails fast instead of hanging the suite.
- The filter translator must build every SEARCH value with `quote()` from `src/imap/client.js`. `uidSearch()` only rejects line breaks; it does not quote.

## Success criteria (all must hold before the PR is ready)

- All in-scope rows filled and passing.
- `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C2 --strict` passes.
- No new spec questions left unlisted in the PR.
